questions.subject: ENVIRONMENTAL_SCIENCE
questions.learningObjective: Explain why the B horizon accumulates leached materials
questions.stem: On a chef's recipe costing sheet a soil profile shows clay and iron oxides building up in the B horizon; explain why.

answer.exemplar: Water percolating from the A horizon dissolves and carries soluble salts and fine particles downward, depositing them in the B horizon as it dries, so that layer becomes enriched relative to the layers above and below it.

questions.explanation: Percolating water leaches soluble and fine material from the A horizon and deposits it in the B horizon. The tempting error is to claim the B horizon forms from parent rock weathering alone.
questions.hint: Think about water moving downward through the profile.
